name: CWE-bench
description: CWE-bench is a defensive cybersecurity benchmark. It measures whether coding agents can find and fix real vulnerabilities in real codebases. v2 has 250 audit-and-patch tasks across 185 distinct CWEs: a public set of 100 tasks (91 CWEs) that anyone can run, and a held-out set of 150 tasks that remains closed. Each task is graded by a deterministic verifier on whether the exploit is closed and legitimate behaviour still works.

citation.name: CWE-bench: Refocusing Agentic Security from Exploitation to Defense

subjectOf.headline: CWE-bench v1: Defense Is the Harder Test
CWE-bench: Measuring Coding Agent Capabilities on Every Class of Known Vulnerability

measurementTechnique: Automated audit-and-patch task graded by a deterministic programmatic verifier: the exploit must no longer work and legitimate behaviour must still hold, with no partial credit.

variableMeasured.name: pass@1
variableMeasured.description: Share of tasks a model solves on the first attempt under the deterministic programmatic verifier, averaged over four rollouts per task.
